description: Stocks exhibit persistent seasonal patterns in returns (e.g., retail in Q4), so momentum computed using only same-month returns from prior years (252-day lookback skipping most recent month) should capture this seasonality and outperform standard momentum; falsified if forward Sharpe is not higher than the best existing 252d-skip-21 momentum strategy (currently 1.68).
title: Seasonal Momentum · 252d skip 21 · Top 500 · Long Only
